description: A narration longer than one take, spoken in one cloned voice and joined without audible seams. Audio8-TTS holds about 95 s of reference, text and speech together (see 'voice-clone'), so a long text is cut into takes at sentence boundaries, each take is spoken with 'voice-clone's own generate_speech arguments under one 'reference_audio', 'reference_text' and 'seed', and the takes are joined in order. 'takes' is a list of strings, and it is a variable rather than a step because the engine expands 'for_each' before a run starts, so the list cannot come from a step of the same workflow: for a plain text use 'narration-long', which cuts the text with 'split_takes' and runs this template as a child workflow with the takes (a child expands its own 'for_each' at its own run). The default is three short takes to show the shape. Each take is followed by 'gap_seconds' of silence (0.3 by default, a first guess to be tuned by ear rather than a measured pause) cut to the take's own sample rate, and 'crossfade_ms' (30 by default) is the overlap at every join: the crossfade also overlaps each take into its gap, so the audible pause is about gap_seconds less one crossfade; the last take keeps its trailing gap, and 'slice_audio' trims it if it matters. The same seed does not make takes sound alike by itself - a different text is a different draw - so listen for a voice that drifts between takes and split into shorter takes if one does; a seam is also where a level step shows, so check the joined file's loudness before relying on it. Consent: clone only a voice you have the right to use - your own, or one whose owner has agreed - and never to impersonate or deceive. There is no default voice: 'reference_audio' (an asset: reference, at most 20 s) and 'reference_text' (exactly what is said in it) are required together, as in 'voice-clone'. The cost rows are priced per take from measured runs whose takes were 25-37 s of speech, so the short default takes cost less: 0.46 min a take on an RTX 3090 (an Audio8 narration of 12 takes, 303.8 s, in 5.5 min, bench/records/drill.md, ask 3) and 0.56 min a take on an M5 Pro (two 'narration-long' runs of 7 takes, about 202 s, in 4.1 and 3.8 min, bench/records/audio.md).

takes: Somebody finished the pistachio and nobody is saying anything.
The fridge hums, and nobody looks up from their phone.
It was a quiet kind of guilt.
variables.reference_text: The words spoken in the reference clip, exactly as said.

summary: A narration longer than one take, spoken in one cloned voice and joined take by take.
